staff.title: Staff console
staff.description: Menuyukti platform tools for team members. Customers do not see this area.

provisionWorkspace.title: Provision workspace
provisionWorkspace.description: Create an operator workspace for a Clerk user. Guests sign up with no workspace; staff provisions pro (restaurant client) so they can add locations and invite team members.

workspacePlan.title: Workspace plan
workspacePlan.description: Manually set a workspace to free (guest / PWA customer) or pro (restaurant client — full operator product). Free gets guest home and profile; pro unlocks locations, inventar, advisor, and the rest of the app.
workspacePlan.noWorkspaceYet: You do not have a workspace yet. Provision one above, or enter another workspace ID.

devData.title: Mock data seed
devData.description: Ingest the same selective seed as make dev-data into a Clerk user’s workspace. Uses committed fixtures (Warung inventar, Kaffeestube analytics). Does not wipe CRM, media, or styles. Disabled in production unless ALLOW_DEV_DATA_INGEST=1.
devData.confirm: Run “{scope}” for this user? This may reset inventar or replace dev-seed analytics runs.
devData.successInventar: Inventar seeded for workspace {workspaceId} ({catalog} catalog, {stock} stock).
devData.successAnalytics: Analytics seeded for workspace {workspaceId} ({orders} orders, run {runId}).
devData.successAll: Inventar + analytics seeded for workspace {workspaceId} ({catalog} catalog, {orders} orders).
devData.successClear: Cleared inventar for workspace {workspaceId}. Locations left intact.
devData.error: Could not ingest mock seed data.

clearServiceData.title: Clear service data
clearServiceData.description: Wipe location-scoped domain data for one service across a Clerk user’s workspace and cancel that service’s active subscriptions. Locations and the workspace are not deleted. Cashback is CRM-scoped and will be rejected. Disabled in production unless ALLOW_DEV_DATA_INGEST=1.
clearServiceData.confirm: Clear all “{service}” data for this user’s workspace? This cannot be undone.
clearServiceData.success: Cleared {service} for workspace {workspaceId} ({locations} locations): predictions {predictions}, votings {votings}, ledger {ledger}, earn rules {rules}, POS {posOrders}, menu categories {menuCategories}, subscriptions {subscriptions}.
